description: tx.sign: signing, sponsorship, key authorizations (limits, call scopes, witness, admin keys, account binding), keychain V1/V2 access keys, expiring nonces, and inputs every SDK must refuse to sign. Scenarios with node run in order on one fresh dev node per adapter, with the bytes that adapter produced.

scenarios.name: minimal
scenarios.description: One TIP-20 transfer call, protocol nonce, no fee token.
scenarios.source: tempo-go transaction_vectors_test.go minimal_transaction; ox TxEnvelopeTempo.test.ts serialize minimal

scenarios.name: second_nonce
scenarios.description: Nonce 1 for the same sender as a prior case in this file (runner sends nonce 0 first).

scenarios.name: with_fee_token
scenarios.description: Explicit fee token preference (pathUSD).

scenarios.name: fee_token_alpha_usd
scenarios.description: Fee token set to a second TIP-20 (AlphaUSD); the sender holds none, so the node rejects it.

scenarios.name: multiple_calls_batch
scenarios.description: Three calls executed atomically.
scenarios.source: tempo-go multiple_calls_batch; ox serialize multiple calls

scenarios.name: zero_value_empty_data
scenarios.description: Call to an EOA with zero value and empty data.

scenarios.name: call_with_value
scenarios.description: Call with non-zero value; Tempo has no native token, so the node rejects it.

scenarios.name: contract_creation
scenarios.description: First call deploys Counter (to = null).

scenarios.name: contract_creation_then_call
scenarios.description: CREATE as the first call followed by a transfer: the only allowed position for CREATE in a batch.

scenarios.name: access_list
scenarios.description: Access list with one address and one storage key.

scenarios.name: user_nonce_key_1
scenarios.description: 2D nonce: nonce key 1.

scenarios.name: user_nonce_key_large
scenarios.description: 2D nonce: 128-bit nonce key.

scenarios.name: valid_before
scenarios.description: Expires in 2100.

scenarios.name: valid_after
scenarios.description: Valid after 1 second past epoch (already valid).

scenarios.name: validity_window
scenarios.description: validAfter < validBefore, both set.

scenarios.name: expired_valid_before
scenarios.description: validBefore in the past: signs, but the node rejects it.

scenarios.name: wrong_chain_id
scenarios.description: Signed for chain 1; the dev node (1337) rejects it.

scenarios.name: expiring_nonce_without_valid_before
scenarios.description: Expiring nonce (nonce key 2^256-1, nonce 0) without validBefore: the node rejects it, since an expiring-nonce transaction must expire within its window.

skipReasons.go: tempo-go refuses to sign an expiring-nonce transaction without validBefore (Tx.Validate, pkg/transaction/transaction.go:204 in v0.6.1, :210 on main), which the node rejects anyway; the reference SDKs sign it and leave the verdict to the node. Not a bug: this scenario records the node's verdict, so it runs on the other SDKs only.

scenarios.name: expiring_nonce_valid_before_too_far
scenarios.description: Expiring nonce with validBefore in 2100, far past the expiring-nonce window: the node rejects it.

scenarios.name: sponsored
scenarios.description: Fee payer co-signs and pays; the sender holds no tokens.
scenarios.source: tempo-go sponsored_transaction; ox serialize with feePayerSignature

scenarios.name: sponsored_with_fee_token
scenarios.description: Fee payer picks the fee token; the sender payload leaves it out.

scenarios.name: key_authorization
scenarios.description: Root signs a tx that also authorizes a secp256k1 access key with a pathUSD limit.
scenarios.source: ox serialize keyAuthorization (secp256k1); tempo-go keychain SignAndAttach

scenarios.name: keychain_access_key
scenarios.description: The access key authorized above signs for the root account (V2 keychain signature).
scenarios.source: tempo-go keychain SignWithAccessKey; ox SignatureEnvelope keychain

scenarios.name: keychain_sponsored
scenarios.description: Access key signs, fee payer co-signs.

scenarios.name: keychain_unauthorized_key
scenarios.description: A key the root never authorized signs for it; the node rejects it.

scenarios.name: keychain_v1_access_key
scenarios.description: The authorized access key signs with the legacy V1 keychain envelope (0x03, inner signature over the plain signing hash), deprecated at T1C: the node rejects it.

skipReasons.go: tempo-go has no keychain V1 signing API: keychain.SignWithAccessKey always writes a V2 envelope (pkg/keychain/keychain.go:14,89-130 in v0.6.1; :14,96-137 on main). Not fixed on tempo-go main (542c18e) either: re-check on the next tempo-go bump. Still unfixed in tempo-go v0.7.0.
skipReasons.python: pytempo has no keychain V1 signing API: KeychainSignature is V2-only in 0.6.2 (pytempo/keychain.py:847, :903); main parses V1 envelopes but KeychainSignature.sign always derives the V2 digest (pytempo/keychain.py:932) and sign_access_key takes no version (models.py:750-770). Not fixed on pytempo main (2a6a4c2) either: re-check on the next pytempo bump. Still unfixed in pytempo 0.7.0.

scenarios.source: ox SignatureEnvelope keychain v1; tempo-primitives KeychainSignature

scenarios.name: key_authorization_expiry_periodic_limit
scenarios.description: Access key with an expiry and a daily pathUSD limit.

scenarios.name: keychain_periodic_key
scenarios.description: The periodic-limit access key signs for its root.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_no_spending
scenarios.description: Access key with limits = [] (no spending allowed).

scenarios.name: keychain_no_spending_transfer
scenarios.description: The no-spending key tries a pathUSD transfer: the pool rejects it (SpendingLimitExceeded).

scenarios.name: key_authorization_call_scopes
scenarios.description: Root authorizes an access key scoped (TIP-1011) to pathUSD transfer() with a recipient allowlist of one address.

skipReasons.python: pytempo has no inline key authorization call scopes (TIP-1011 allowed_calls): KeyAuthorization always writes the field absent (pytempo/keychain.py:596 in 0.6.2, :590 on main). Not fixed on pytempo main (2a6a4c2) either: re-check on the next pytempo bump. Still unfixed in pytempo 0.7.0.

scenarios.name: keychain_scoped_allowed_call
scenarios.description: The scoped key calls pathUSD transfer() to its allowed recipient.

scenarios.name: keychain_scoped_other_recipient
scenarios.description: The scoped key calls pathUSD transfer() to a recipient outside its allowlist: the call reverts.

scenarios.name: keychain_scoped_other_selector
scenarios.description: The scoped key calls pathUSD approve(), a selector outside its scope: the call reverts.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_deny_all_calls
scenarios.description: Root authorizes an access key with allowedCalls = [] (scoped mode, no call allowed).

skipReasons.python: pytempo has no inline key authorization call scopes (TIP-1011 allowed_calls): KeyAuthorization always writes the field absent (pytempo/keychain.py:596 in 0.6.2, :590 on main). Not fixed on pytempo main (2a6a4c2) either: re-check on the next pytempo bump. Still unfixed in pytempo 0.7.0.

scenarios.name: keychain_deny_all_calls_transfer
scenarios.description: The deny-all key tries a pathUSD transfer: the node includes it and the call reverts.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_witness
scenarios.description: Key authorization carrying a TIP-1053 witness.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_zero_witness
scenarios.description: Key authorization with the all-zero witness, which is a present witness, not an absent one.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_admin_key
scenarios.description: Root authorizes a TIP-1049 admin access key bound to its own account.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_account_bound
scenarios.description: Root-signed key authorization bound (TIP-1049 account field) to the root account itself.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_wrong_account
scenarios.description: Key authorization bound to an account other than the transaction sender: the node rejects it.

scenarios.name: key_authorization_mixed_limits
scenarios.description: One one-off pathUSD limit and one periodic AlphaUSD limit in the same authorization.

scenarios.name: keychain_self_authorized_sponsored
scenarios.description: An access key signs (keychain V2) the transaction that carries its own root-signed authorization, and a fee payer co-signs.
scenarios.source: viem/tempo Account access keys; ox keyAuthorization + keychain

scenarios.name: keychain_self_authorized
scenarios.description: An access key signs the transaction carrying its own authorization; the root pays.

scenarios.name: keychain_v1_self_authorized
scenarios.description: Same as keychain_self_authorized with a legacy V1 keychain envelope: the node rejects it.

skipReasons.go: tempo-go has no keychain V1 signing API: keychain.SignWithAccessKey always writes a V2 envelope (pkg/keychain/keychain.go:14,89-130 in v0.6.1; :14,96-137 on main). Not fixed on tempo-go main (542c18e) either: re-check on the next tempo-go bump. Still unfixed in tempo-go v0.7.0.

Not fixed on pytempo main (2a6a4c2) either: re-check on the next pytempo bump. Still unfixed in pytempo 0.7.0.

scenarios.name: keychain_contract_creation
scenarios.description: An access key signs a transaction whose call is a CREATE: the node rejects it (access keys cannot deploy contracts).

scenarios.name: tempo_go_minimal_transaction
scenarios.description: tempo-go golden: chain 1, anvil key 0, no node submission.

scenarios.name: reject_empty_calls
scenarios.description: calls = [] is invalid.

scenarios.name: reject_inverted_validity_window
scenarios.description: validAfter > validBefore.

scenarios.name: reject_equal_validity_window
scenarios.description: validAfter == validBefore.

scenarios.name: reject_tip_above_fee_cap
scenarios.description: maxPriorityFeePerGas > maxFeePerGas.

skipReasons.rust: tempo-primitives 1.11.0 TempoTransaction::validate (crates.io, tempo_transaction.rs) does not check maxPriorityFeePerGas <= maxFeePerGas; ox and the node reject it. tempo main checks it (crates/primitives/src/transaction/tempo_transaction.rs:359-363) but no newer tempo-primitives is on crates.io yet.

scenarios.name: reject_create_not_first_call
scenarios.description: CREATE as the second call of a batch: only the first call may be a CREATE.

skipReasons.go: tempo-go Tx.Validate (pkg/transaction/transaction.go:171) does not check CREATE placement (only the first call may be a CREATE, and only one), so tempo-go signs batches tempo-primitives refuses (tempo_transaction.rs validate_calls) and the node rejects. Not fixed on tempo-go main (542c18e) either: re-check on the next tempo-go bump. Still unfixed in tempo-go v0.7.0.

Not fixed in ox yet: re-check on the next ox bump.
